tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bod khams bde thabs yan lag chos: 'gro don ma ṇi bskul ba bzhugs:1$0000300 ྈ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'i don du ma ṇi 'ur dbyangs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: yul ris rgyal khams sa phyogs 'di'i nad yams 'khrug rtsod zhi ba dang bde skyid 'dzom pa'i phyir du ma ṇi 'ur dbyangs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dbang yon maṇḍal dang yun du zhabs pad brtan cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i don du ma ṇi 'ur dbyangs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: sgos bka' drin can gyis byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: 'dir 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan pho mo rnams: dbang chos 'di don ldan mdzad par zhu: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: deng mjal ba'i mtshan ldan bla ma 'di: rje sangs rgyas dbyer med spyi bor sgoms: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: lha thugs rje chen po spyi bor sgoms: ngag yi ge drug ma'i gsol 'debs mdzod: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: sems byams dang snying rje chen po sgoms: chos byas tshad 'gro ba'i don du mdzod: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: 'jigs brgyad dang nad gdon gang byung yang: 'jigs skyob kyi yi ge drug ma dbyangs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: lus mi rtag pa ni mngon sum la: yongs 'khor ba 'di la snying po med: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: chos dge ba bcu po bsgrub pa dang: sdig mi dge bcu po spang bar bya: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: de ltar du mdzad pa'i phan yon gyis: tshe 'di dang phyi ma bde legs 'byung: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: spyir rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis shog: sgos 'dir 'tshogs khrom la bkra shis shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐:
zhes bod khams bde thabs kyi yan lag 'gro don chos bcu'i nang nas khol du phyungs pa'o// //
